rawUninstallerName: Uninstall The Planet Crafter Achievement Tracker.exe

copy.readyBody: A focused local companion for The Planet Crafter achievements, Steam state and optional world-save context.
copy.readyNote: The tracker is read-only. It does not modify saves, Steam data or The Planet Crafter files.
copy.completeBody: The achievement tracker is installed and ready to read your local Steam state.
copy.removeBody: Remove the Project Eden tracker from this PC. The Planet Crafter, Steam and world saves remain untouched.
copy.uninstallCompleteBody: Project Eden has been removed. The Planet Crafter and its saves were not changed.
